scams.name: The Overpriced Seafood Catch
scams.avoidance: Ask for the specific price in dollars before ordering any market-rate item Get a price estimate for the total meal before you order Check Google reviews specifically mentioning 'bill' or 'price surprise'
scams.location: Seafood restaurants near Clarke Quay, East Coast

scams.name: The Airport Currency Exchange Trap
scams.avoidance: Exchange only a small emergency amount at the airport Head to Tanjong Pagar Plaza or Lucky Plaza in Orchard for Singapore's best exchange rates Wise or Revolut debit cards offer near-interbank rates anywhere

scams.name: The 'Charity' Beggar Gang
scams.avoidance: Donate to registered charities rather than street solicitors Singapore has robust social services — genuine destitution is rarely this organized
scams.location: CBD, South Bridge Road, Orchard Road

scams.name: The Gem / Investment Sales Pitch
scams.avoidance: Genuine investment-grade gem deals don't happen on the street Any claim you're getting a special price unavailable to locals is a red flag

scams.name: The Tiger Balm Gardens Touting Area
scams.avoidance: Buy all attraction tickets directly from official websites or apps Singapore's major attractions are almost always cheaper to pre-book online officially
scams.location: Sentosa, Gardens by the Bay entry areas
